description: This Java class defines various services related to subscription management within the Apache OFBiz framework, including extending subscriptions, processing order-based subscriptions, handling expiration events, and maintaining subscription records.

classes.name: SubscriptionServices
classes.description: A collection of static methods providing subscription management functionalities such as extending subscriptions, handling expiration, linking subscriptions to products or orders, and scheduled expiry processing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: processExtendSubscription
methods.description: Extends or creates a subscription record based on existing subscriptions, updating or creating records with new date ranges according to use time and unit.

methods.name: processExtendSubscriptionByProduct
methods.description: Handles extension of subscriptions related to a specific product, possibly multiple times depending on product configurations and quantity.

methods.name: processExtendSubscriptionByOrder
methods.description: Processes an entire order, extending subscriptions for each product in the order, based on the order information.

methods.name: runServiceOnSubscriptionExpiry
methods.description: Checks active subscriptions for expiry conditions and triggers associated services upon expiration, updating records accordingly.

methods.name: runSubscriptionExpired
methods.description: A placeholder service that indicates a subscription has expired and has been processed.
